dispatch.conflict: Settings changed. Review the latest values and save again.
dispatch.title: Card dispatch
dispatch.loadError: Could not load card dispatch settings.
dispatch.reviewMeetsDependency: Count cards awaiting review as complete
dispatch.startReleasedHelp: Starts cards as soon as their prerequisites finish, regardless of concurrency limits or queue order. Central dispatch overrides this setting.
dispatch.policyConflict: The policy changed. Review the latest version and save again.
dispatch.centralHelp: The first eligible model orders queued cards. Each card's settings determine its worker model.
dispatch.usageFreshness: Uses usage data observed within the last 5 minutes. Dispatch resumes after fresh usage data arrives following a limit reset.
dispatch.archiveFolderPlaceholder: Leave blank to create a folder at the first decision
dispatch.parentFolderPlaceholder: Leave blank to create it at the top level
dispatch.archiveFolderHelp: If the chosen folder is deleted, archived, or restricted, dispatch will keep that folder setting.
